title: iShowSpeed's Haunted House Stream Ends Early
excerpt: iShowSpeed visited the Warren House, but fans were left dismayed as the YouTube didn't spend the night at the "world's most haunted house"....
content:
iShowSpeed’s Warren House Stream Ends Early Despite Overnight Promise

Darren “iShowSpeed” Watkins Jr. announced that he would be spending the night at the “world’s most haunted house”, but the livestream ended early, leaving fans disappointed.

Fans began speculating that Speed would spend the night at the Conjuring House after the YouTuber scheduled a livestream titled “Spending the Night in the World’s Scariest House”. However, those expectations were dashed when the stream began and Rick Clark appeared as Speed’s guide at the Warren House.

Despite the mix-up, both fans and iShowSpeed continued to refer to the property as the Warren House and the Conjuring House. This is understandable given the Warren House’s links to the paranormal investigators who inspired the Conjuring universe. Many fans were also left dismayed when iShowSpeed ended the stream in less than two hours, rather than staying overnight as the title had suggested.

iShowSpeed meets Annabelle the doll; Jeffy says the code word to end the livestream

iShowSpeed showed up at the haunted house and was greeted by Rick, who told the YouTuber about having “investigated things alongside Ed Warren” and knowing the Warren House “like the back of his hand”. Rick then told Speed about a skeptical anniversary guest who didn’t believe in ghosts but was apparently pushed and held down by one. This set the mood, and Rick went on to pull a prank on Speed by banging on the wall, which scared the Streamer of the Year 2026 contender. Jeffy also tried to scare Speed by hiding under a black cover in the house’s basement.

iShowSpeed used an SLS camera, which made for one of the scariest moments of the livestream, as it apparently detected a human-looking figure and the door slammed shut on its own. There were several other similar moments where fans were left wondering whether the house is really haunted. For instance, a towel was seemingly moving on its own in the background. A Cymbal-banging monkey toy randomly started on its own, and even Speed’s cameraman, Darel, experienced being scratched on his leg.

There were several light-hearted moments on the stream as well, including Speed misnaming food and his brother, Jamal, getting annoyed. This is normal banter between the two brothers on stream, so it wasn’t surprising. Speed also picked up a random doll inside the Warren House, naming her Stephine. Rick agreed with the name and said the doll would keep the name. Jamal also randomly appeared on stream, which made Speed and viewers flinch. iShowSpeed and his team also saw Annabelle the doll, with both Speed and Jeffy asking the doll funny questions.

A fan apparently dressed as Momo also appeared outside the Warren House and mysteriously disappeared from view. At the end of the stream, iShowSpeed was trying to talk to a ghost, but Jeffy said green apples, which abruptly ended the stream. This left viewers hanging, as they were ready for an all-night stream, but Speed was only live for less than two hours in his seasonal broadcast.
